answer: Tie each identity to a decaying work ledger: your voice rises like a comet only while you keep producing graded original answers, and stalls at a hard zenith set by per-epoch emission caps. A sybil gale of fresh accounts then buys nothing - every clone starts at zero standing, pays full inference cost per round, and the fixed pool splits thinner with each fake seat while duplicate detection slashes correlated submissions. Attack cost scales linearly; attack revenue does not.
